message.content: {"question":"How much is the gravitational force F and energy U exerted between two homogeneous spherical masses M₁ and M₂, if the distance between their centers is r, with r greater than the radii of each mass?","options":{"A":"F = -GM₁M₂r/r³; U = GM₁M₂/r","B":"F = -GM₁M₂r/r²; U = GM₁M₂/r²","C":"F = -GM₁M₂/r²; U = GM₁M₂/r","D":"F = -GM₁M₂r/r³; U = GM₁M₂/r²"},"correct":"C"}
